operating_notes.text: Zaggle modified Dice acquisition to asset purchase comprising software, IP, and contracts for ~₹67.9 Cr.
Q4FY26 revenue mix: Propel platform/gift cards ₹382.16 Cr (61.8%), program fee ₹221.83 Cr (35.9%), platform/SaaS fee ₹13.92 Cr (2.3%).
FY26 operating cash flow negative ₹51.47 Cr as trade receivables rose to ₹361.18 Cr at Mar-2026.
IPO proceeds of ₹362.16 Cr fully utilised as at Mar-31, 2026; QIP net proceeds ₹574.14 Cr with ₹382.84 Cr unutilised.
Completed acquisitions of Greenedge Enterprises and Rivpe Technology (rebranded as Zagg.Money) and established Zaggle Payments IFSC Ltd in GIFT City.
Venkatesh Ramachandran appointed as Group CFO effective May 18, 2026.
Entered into a 1-year agreement with Bikaji Foods International to provide Zaggle Save employee expense management and benefits.
Active users reached 3.9 million across 3,900+ corporate customers.
Q1FY27 revenue mix: SaaS platform fees ₹12.5 Cr (2.95%), program fees ₹160 Cr (37.79%), Propel points ₹251 Cr (59.34%)
DICE acquisition cost of ₹3 Cr absorbed in Q1FY27 with no revenue recognition, expected to start from Q2FY27
Zagg.Money annualized run rate increased by 2.3x to 84,000 cards from 36,000 in previous 8-week window
Entered into a 1-year agreement with AGP City Gas Private Limited to provide Zaggle Propel platform, with fees linked to active users and voucher redemptions.

timeline.summary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services entered into a three-year agreement with The Supreme Industries Limited to provide its Propel reward platform.
Shareholders approved Mr. Avinash Ramesh Godkhindi’s re-appointment as Managing Director and CEO via remote e-voting on May 04, 2026, with 99.9964% voting in favor.
On May 8, 2026, Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services modified its acquisition of Dice Enterprises to an asset purchase of software, IP, and contracts for ₹67.9 Cr.
Zaggle Prepaid executed an amendment to its customer service agreement with Honasa Consumer on May 8, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹617.92 Cr (+49.9% YoY), net profit ₹40.6 Cr (+30.4% YoY).
On May 13, 2026, Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹617.92 Cr and PAT of ₹40.6 Cr.
Zaggle Prepaid appointed Venkatesh Ramachandran as Group CFO effective May 18, 2026.
On May 13, 2026, Zaggle Prepaid submitted monitoring agency reports for its IPO and QIP for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
On May 15, 2026, Zaggle Prepaid entered into an agreement with Bikaji Foods International to provide Zaggle Save employee expense management services for 1 year.
Zaggle Prepaid reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹618 Cr (+50% YoY) and guided FY27 standalone growth at 25-30%.
On May 22, 2026, Zaggle Prepaid received an exchange clarification request regarding XBRL financial results discrepancies.
On May 29, 2026, Zaggle Prepaid clarified and rectified consolidated EPS discrepancies in its XBRL financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 14, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹423 Cr (+28% YoY) and reaffirming FY27 consolidated revenue growth guidance at 40%
Entered into a 1-year agreement with AGP City Gas to provide the Zaggle Propel platform on variable monthly usage fees.
